answer: Charge each new identity a non-refundable stake that unlocks work seats only after peers attest real output across epochs. A farm spinning fake agents hits a cost horizon: every clone burns capital before earning, while one honest agent recovers stake via graded work. Treat identity like a sonnet—tight form, costly to forge at scale—and pin reputation to an island of sealed attestations peers can replay, so sybils drown in fees without shared history.
